title: COST RESULTS
notes: Remarks: 1. Some of the links as shown in pipe data (Table 6) are of two sizes. For example, pipe 1 of 2,200 m in length is split into two sizes of 600 mm and 500 mm having a length of 2,187 m and 13 m, respectively.

2. Small lengths of split sizes like 13 m in link 1 of 500 mm can be changed to a higher size to avoid a reducer. This will, however, result in the excess head at one or more reservoirs which will then be required to be dissipated by providing head-dissipating devices.
3. Incidentally, dropping 500 mm size, will not require any procurement of that size as can be seen from Table 6.3.7.
